description: Fetch Context7 documentation for a topic and write it to disk.

functions.name: fetch_and_store
functions.summary: Resolve a library id, fetch docs, and write a markdown file.

params.name: output_dir
params.description: Directory to write the docs into.

returns.description: Library id, topic, and output path.

examples.title: Fetch Next.js routing docs
examples.code:
import skills

async def main():
    result = await skills.load("docs-to-files").fetch_and_store(
        library="/vercel/next.js",
        topic="routing",
        output_dir="output/docs",
    )
    return result
